title.zh: 形成的配准关系改变复制保真度

claim.zh: 对每个字母表与汲取律：在每一位接合配准所读之物的复制产生某词，当且仅当每一位读出该词的记号、池供给该词且支持覆盖其汲取，其产物只增长；对每个过程，每步延长输出当且仅当每段进程延长输出，每个非门控步保持的量沿每段非门控进程保持。配准机中，对每个状态，与词长相同数目的复制步把产物延长为该词，当且仅当每一位经实际连接读出其记号、池供给该词且支持覆盖其汲取；完整稳定配准恢复既有复制是其实例；每段进程使产物的边为其记号上的路径，所以完整配准复制模板（含边）当且仅当模板的边是该路径。缺接、错位与重接通过改变各位所读而改变后继；只有复制步改变产物，故连接变化不改写产物，每个允许的有限历史保留已成前缀及连接件、材料与支持的总量。消耗连接件和支持形成的配准接入材料复制。
claim.en: For every alphabet and law of draws: a copy attaching at each site what its contacts read there produces a word exactly when every site reads the word's token, the pool supplies the word and the support covers what it draws, and its product only grows; for every process an output is extended along every course exactly when every step extends it, and a quantity kept by every ungated step is kept along every ungated course. In the contact machine, for every state, as many copy moves as a word has tokens extend the product by that word exactly when each site reads its token through the actual contacts, the pool supplies it and the support covers what it draws; complete stable contacts recovering prior copying are the instance; every course keeps the product's bonds the path on its tokens, so complete contacts copy the template, bonds included, exactly when its bonds are that path. Loss, displacement and rebinding change the successor by changing what sites read; only copy moves change the product, so contact changes never rewrite it, and every admitted finite history keeps its built prefix and its totals of connectors, material and support. Contact formation consuming connectors and support enters material copying.

hypotheses.zh: 索引位置与选择性对接、可靠取值、局部接合成本及事件发生给定；没有切除或替换已成产物的操作。
hypotheses.en: Indexed sites, selective docking, reliable transduction, local attachment costs and event occurrence are supplied; there is no excision or replacement of built material.

hypotheses.zh: 一般继承组合要求完整值配准、模板与前缀／剩余序列一致，且保留原定理的路径及材料／支持前提（非空前提不需要）。
hypotheses.en: The general inheritance composition requires every value read through complete contacts and template/prefix/suffix consistency, retaining the prior path and material/support premises (the nonempty premise is not needed).

correspondence.zh: 角色由共同活动中的对接、取值、移入与保留关系分化；配准为实际位置对，并非成功标签。局部辨别规律仍在等索引对接条件中给定。
correspondence.en: Roles differentiate through docking, reading, transfers and retention in common activity; reading through contacts consists of actual position pairs, not a success flag. Local discrimination remains supplied by the equal-index docking guard.

detail.zh: registered_operation_refines 将注册后的运行对应到旧步骤；registered_inheritance 实际调用 copied_structure_inherits。
detail.en: registered_operation_refines relates execution through contacts to the old steps; registered_inheritance directly uses copied_structure_inherits.

output.zh: 旧逐项复制在非空路径与明确供给下形成同结构后继。
output.en: The old tokenwise copying process forms an identical daughter under its nonempty-path and declared-supply conditions.

input.zh: 新过程的工作投影经完整配准及顺序一致性对应到旧复制。
input.en: The new work projection refines the old copying process under complete contacts and order consistency.

conditions.zh: 连接在所比较的连续复制操作中保持；损失／错位的混合历史不自动满足。
conditions.en: Contacts remain stable during the compared copying operations; mixed histories with loss/displacement need not qualify.

detail.zh: 缺接可在有材料和支持时停滞；连接错位未必改值，重接不追改旧产物，连接数和全部复制状态相同仍可产出不同序列。
detail.en: Missing contacts stall despite stock/support; displacement need not change the value, rebinding does not rewrite old output, and matched contact counts/full copying state can produce different sequences.

limitations.zh: 未导出索引识别／取值规律、损伤率、纠错启动、切除机制、自供或种群选择；同等接触机制的强对手具有相同解释能力。
limitations.en: Indexed recognition/transduction, damage rates, repair initiation, excision, autonomous provision and population selection are not derived; a strong rival retaining the same contact mechanism has the same explanatory capacity.

validation_scope.zh: 33项新定理声明／54项新审计，484项实际闭包审计中430项继承分列；原始论文作为既有比较重读，无新经验复算。一般律已由检查器回执绑定。
validation_scope.en: 33 new theorem declarations / 54 new audits, with 430 inherited declarations separate in 484 actual-closure audits. The original paper is reread as the existing comparator, without new empirical reanalysis. General laws: checker receipts bound.

next_delta.zh: formed-copying-correction 已接通已成产物的编辑与后继；继续参考关系的取得／更新、故障定位、支持再生及明确共同分配。
next_delta.en: formed-copying-correction now joins editing of an existing product and its successor; continue acquisition/renewal of the reference relation, fault localization, support renewal and explicit shared allocation.

history.en: 16 October 2026, P114, the apart modules read on the shared base (study section 138; Ren, 15 October: “so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”): the main law stated on the shared base, no premise added: a plan of k moves of a determined law completes exactly when the goal holds on its orbit at k (completes_units_iff), and the moves of a copy reading through contacts go along its law's orbit (readSteps_orbit). Where as many tokens are pending as the word has, the reading copy's plan of word.length moves completes with the word added to the product exactly when every site reads the word's token, the pool supplies the word and the support covers its draws (reading_completes_iff); the copy's product only grows along every course of its process (copy_grows). Becoming.Courses is compiled and audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T172257.067968Z), with empty axiom reports. Claims, hypotheses, Ren's words, dependencies and the earlier proofs are unchanged; only references, bindings, aliases and this entry are added.
